name: 77026 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77026 (Houston) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77026 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
